  1. solvers

Uses of Package
solvers

Packages that use solvers
Package
Description
analytical
Analytical JMVA model layer: constants, parameters and the model data structure of the alphanumeric MVA solver, as described in the JMVA chapter of the user manual.
jmva.panels
Panels of the JMVA wizard: Classes, Stations, Service Times, Service Demands, Visits, Reference Stations, What-if and Comment tabs, as described in the JMVA chapter of the user manual.
jmva.utilities
Utilities of the JMVA GUI.
solvers
Solution algorithms of JMVA.
solvers.dispatchers
Solver dispatchers of JMVA, which select and drive the appropriate exact or approximate solution algorithm for the model under study.
solvers.dispatchers.wrappers
Wrapper solvers used by the JMVA dispatchers.
solvers.multiSolverAlgorithms
Multiclass solution algorithms of JMVA: exact MVA, RECAL, MoM, CoMoM, TreeMVA and TreeConvolution for closed multiclass models, together with their approximate variants.
solvers.singleSolverAlgorithms
Single class solution algorithms of JMVA: exact MVA, stabilized exact MVA for load dependent stations, open model solution and related single class solvers.

  • Classes in solvers used by solvers
    Class
    Description
    Solver
    Solver is an abstract class, which contains the methods to initialize and solve models with a single class of jobs.
    SolverAlgorithm
    Enum class for all implemented algorithm solvers
    SolverMulti
    SolverMulti is an abstract class, which contains the methods initialize and solve multiclass models.
    SolverMultiClosedCoMoM
    Solves a multiclass closed model with the exact CoMoM (Class Oriented Method of Moments) algorithm [Cas09], one of the exact solution techniques available in JMVA for closed product form queueing networks.
    SolverMultiClosedRECAL
    Solves a multiclass closed model with the exact RECAL (Recursion by Chain Algorithm) algorithm [CG86], one of the exact solution techniques available in JMVA for closed product form queueing networks.
    SolverMultiIterative
    Iterative multiclass solution algorithm of JMVA, base of the approximate iterative solvers.
